subject: Post-call: stakeholder roster, procurement timeline, and next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@novacare.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: stakeholder roster, procurement timeline, and next steps

Hi Sofia & Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to make scheduling the next meeting straightforward:

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference latency for clinical search, centralize model governance across product teams, and lower per-token costs for embedding-based features.
- Technical constraints: must deploy within your VPC for PHI-sensitive flows; SOC 2 evidence and a short security questionnaire will be required.
- Initial perf target: p95 < 250ms for 256-token requests; throughput target for pilot ~ 60rps.

Can you please send two things by end of week so we can put together a tailored pilot plan:
1) A short stakeholder roster / org chart that shows the economic buyer (or who signs PO), the security/legal contact, and procurement lead. If there’s a central platform sponsor, mark them too.
2) An estimated procurement timeline (target PO date, required legal steps, any gate meetings).

I’ve copied Marissa (solutions) to help draft the pilot scope once we have the roster. If it’s easier, feel free to forward the org chart PDF directly — we can annotate it with suggested meeting owners.

Attachments: referenced templates (if helpful) — we’ll send a one-page pilot outline after we get the roster.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | [m] (415) 555-0182

From: Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@novacare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@novacare.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T10:05:34-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: stakeholder roster, procurement timeline, and next steps

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attaching our org chart and a rough procurement timeline. Quick notes:
- Economic buyer is likely Clara Ortiz (CFO). I’ve highlighted her on the chart.
- Security & privacy contact is Tom (copied) for technical questions; legal will need a short SLA + data processing addendum.
- Procurement estimates a 4–6 week window for standard SaaS deals; if there are unusual terms expect 8–10 weeks.

We’re attaching: novacare-org-chart.pdf and procurement-schedule.xlsx for your team to review.

On scheduling — Clara is only available afternoons; would you be able to do a 30-min session the week of Aug 30 to align scope and commercial approach?

Best,
Sofia Marin
Director of Product Operations
Novacare Health

Subject: Re: Post-call: stakeholder roster, procurement timeline, and next steps

Thanks Sofia — this is exactly what we needed. Looping in Aditya (security) and Marissa (solutions) to outline the SOC 2 artifacts and a short DPA template we can share.

Aditya / Marissa — quick asks so we can come prepared for the Clara session if it’s confirmed:
- Aditya: can you prepare a one-page list of SOC 2 artifacts, encryption/KMS options, and a short note on our private VPC deployment model?
- Marissa: can you draft a 1-page pilot scope that hits the perf goals Sofia mentioned and includes an estimated cost range for a 6-week pilot?

Sofia/Tom — if Clara can do afternoons, would Aug 31 at 2:00pm PT work for a 30-min alignment (Clara + Tom + Sofia)? If so we’ll send a calendar invite and a 1-pager in advance.

Quoting your attachment note:
> We’re attaching: novacare-org-chart.pdf and procurement-schedule.xlsx for your team to review.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turn.
Evelyn

From: Tom Li <tom.li@novacare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Marin <sofia.marin@novacare.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T09:03:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: stakeholder roster, procurement timeline, and next steps

Evelyn —

Aug 31 at 2:00pm PT works for Clara and me. I’ll ask Legal to review the DPA draft after Aditya sends it; procurement flagged two non-standard items they may push back on (indemnity cap and data retention limits).

For the Clara session, please include:
- A one-slide summary of risks & mitigations (security + data residency).
- High-level pricing band for the pilot and fail-open rollback plan if perf targets aren’t met.

I’ve uploaded the org chart to our internal drive and shared to the calendar invite after you send it.

Thanks,
